notes:
CIRCUIT: a single loop - an AC current source 8cos(9t-70deg) A on the left, up through a 4 ohm resistor, into a parallel LC tank (5 uF over 10 mH), out through a 5 ohm resistor and down through the 12sin(3t) V AC source; the bottom rail is the ground return and carries the GND symbol. 7 components, 5 nets.

NET MAP:
  n4 = left column x~150 from the top terminal of I-AC #5 (149,540) up to (150,458) and right to the left lead of R #2 (4 ohm). 2 terminals.
  n1 = wire from the right lead of R #2 (267,472) east to the tank's left bar x~352, which runs from the capacitor's left lead (418,411) down to the inductor's left lead (425,519). 3 terminals: R#2, C#0, L#3.
  n2 = the tank's right bar x~592 joining the capacitor's right lead (494,410) and the inductor's right lead (538,521), then east to the left lead of R #1 (5 ohm) at (632,464). 3 terminals.
  n3 = from the right lead of R #1 (747,469) east to the corner (840,458) and down to the top terminal of V-AC #4 (842,531). 2 terminals.
  0  = bottom rail y~665 from the bottom of I-AC #5 (155,639) east to the bottom of V-AC #4 (859,616), with the GND #6 stub dropping at x~507. 3 terminals.

JUDGEMENT CALLS (all three CRITICAL sites are plain Ts, no crossing reading exists):
  S7 (352,475) - the wire from R #2 ends on the tank's left bar; the bar continues above and below. Junction. Treating it as a crossing would strand the 4 ohm resistor on a one-terminal net.
  S6 (592,464) - the wire to R #1 ends on the tank's right bar. Junction, same argument.
  S13 (507,665) - the GND stub drops from the bottom rail; the rail continues left and right. Junction (its hop score of 3.6 is a false positive - the 5x crop shows a clean T with no arc and no jog). All GND symbols sit on net '0', and the crossing reading would leave GND alone on a one-terminal net.
  Non-critical sites S1/S2 ('5 uF' caption over the capacitor leads), S4 ('5 ohm' caption over R #1's right lead) and S8-S11 ('10 mH' caption over the inductor) are handwriting touching wire ink; left at default, none changes the netlist.

PORT FIX: V-AC #4 terminal 0 was pointing at p3 (801,566), a stroke of the handwritten 'V' in the caption '12 sin(3t) V' that touches the source's bounding box on the left. Retargeted to p1 (842,531), the real top lead (153 px of wire running up to the corner at (840,458) and west to R #1). This merged the tracer's two one-terminal nets n3 (R #1 right lead) and n5 (the source) into a single net, clearing both ERC warnings. The other flagged port candidates are all caption ink and correctly unused: C #0 p2/p3 = the 'uF' strokes, R #1 p0/p2/p3/p5 = the '5 ohm' strokes, L #3 p2-p6 = the '10 mH' strokes.

CLASSES: no changes. #5 is the circle with a sine and an arrow inside = I-AC (current source, caption '8cos(9t-70) A'); #4 is the circle with a sine only = V-AC (caption '12 sin(3t) V'). Both 2-terminal, so terminal order is not scored. No 3-terminal parts. Nothing unresolved.
